doc: Curated teardown audit. emit-report.mjs renders this into teardown-report.html (pipeline | issues | explainer tabs). Rules: every score carries evidence (file + whyScore + excerpts); suspicions get verify:true, never asserted; an uncited score is itself a finding.

meta.name: <project>
meta.conduit: one-line artifact flow, e.g. 'request → parse → validate → execute → persist → respond'

contract.label: CONTRACT
contract.blurb: the single source of truth: spec/schema/config root

parts.label: spec / schema file
parts.what: what it does, one concrete sentence
parts.why: what trusts it and why it exists
parts.breaks: what silently fails if this changes
parts.whyScore: the evidence for the score — parity test at file:line

domain.label: DOMAIN
domain.blurb: the business rules the system exists to run

world.label: WORLD
world.blurb: the live environment and its feedback into the top

fixes.spec_root: recommendation text — merged into the part dossier at report time
